# Updating beliefs: the stiffness of skull bone {#sec-updating}

::: {.callout-note}
Draft chapter, in progress.
:::

How stiff is the cortical bone of the human skull? In this chapter we answer
that question the Bayesian way: we write down what we believe before seeing
any data, then update that belief one tensile test at a time, using the
measurements of @wood1969.
